feedback.delta: Preserve a tiny learned background cognition/routing head only as bounded candidate selector with deterministic fallback and auditable outcome stream.
state_version + allowed_actions/mask + selected_action + behavior_logprob + value + outcome + reward_components + model_version must be replayable typed data.
Subconscious policy may prioritize candidate thoughts/actions but must never assign epistemic authority.
Policy distribution can be represented as candidates but no historical evidence justifies conflating PPO probability with hyperposition truth/state.
Graph transition lineage from state/version -> allowed set -> selection -> outcome -> reward -> learner update, preserving fallback provenance.
Persist and test explicit transition/model/action-mask schema versions; silent failed writes must be impossible to classify as learner-active.
Mask train/select equivalence, fallback transition completeness, missing-column migration, N->N+1 action compatibility, learner-stalled-but-service-healthy, policy-collapse rollback.
Service uptime/training loss/entropy/reflection storage are not evidence of useful cognition; require behavioral and counterfactual effects.
Reuse bounded small-head training and anti-degeneration lessons for MVC/other personal learners, while retaining GOLD/SILVER provenance, shadow promotion, open-set tests and rollback.
Index PF-SUB-FAIL-001..005 as mandatory questions for any continuously learning small policy/classifier.
